decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. This strategy is supported by card draw spells like Opt and Sleight of Hand, as well as removal spells like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse. The deck also utilizes cheap spells like Consider and Galvanic Iteration to trigger the Arclight Phoenix's ability. The inclusion of Treasure Cruise and Hall of Storm Giants provide additional card advantage and finishers to close out the game. The deck aims to be fast-paced and aggressive, overwhelming opponents with efficient spells and recursive threats.

This deck focuses on generating a large amount of life gain through various creatures and spells, allowing the player to build up their life total quickly. The aim is to utilize this life gain to power up Aetherflux Reservoir and activate its ability to deal lethal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes creatures that can help search for key pieces and protect the player from threats. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling to help assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently.

The primary focus of this deck is to utilize versatile control spells and creature removal in combination with Niv-Mizzet Reborn to generate card advantage and outvalue opponents. The deck contains a mix of removal spells, ramp cards, and versatile creatures to support the control game plan. Additionally, the inclusion of Bring to Light allows for flexibility in accessing specific cards when needed. The presence of Leyline Binding can also disrupt opponents' strategies and further enhance the controlling aspect of the deck.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing powerful spirits such as Supreme Phantom and Spell Queller, along with efficient card draw from Curious Obsession, the deck can quickly apply pressure while also controlling the board. The key strategy involves creating tempo advantages through bounce effects like Rattlechains and protection spells like Lofty Denial. Mutavault adds additional flexibility and reach, making it difficult for opponents to stabilize. The overall goal is to maintain a fast pace and force opponents to react defensively while steadily building towards victory.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards like Consider, Opt, and Sleight of Hand, in order to bring Arclight Phoenix back from the graveyard for repeated attacks. Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe provide removal while Hall of Storm Giants and Ledger Shredder help control the board. Picklock Prankster is used to disrupt the opponent's plans, and Treasure Cruise helps to refill your hand with cards to keep up the aggression. Overall, the deck aims to be fast and relentless in attacking the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to focus on aggro strategies while also utilizing green devotion as a key mechanic. By including powerful green creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns, as well as cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to ramp up mana production, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and efficient creature-based strategy. Additional cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival help to further enhance the deck's ability to accelerate and maintain board presence, making it a formidable force in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by utilizing a combination of hand disruption spells such as Duress and Thoughtseize, removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, and powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil. The deck also aims to control the board with cards like Sheoldred's Edict and Invoke Despair, while also utilizing powerful creatures such as Reckoner Bankbuster and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out the game. The deck also includes utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Field of Ruin to further control the game.

This UW control deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The deck utilizes permission spells like Censor and Dovin's Veto to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also including board wipes like Supreme Verdict and spot removal like Portable Hole. Memory Deluge and Narset, Parter of Veils provide card advantage and selection. With a variety of lands that provide utility, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents to secure victory in a slow and methodical manner.

The focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy with a combination of counterspells, hand disruption, and removal spells while generating card advantage through powerful planeswalkers like Jace Reawakened and Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Valki, God of Lies to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. The mana base is designed to provide consistent access to both blue and black sources, while also including utility lands like Field of Ruin and Geier Reach Sanitarium.

The deck focuses on using Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful control tool, with a diverse array of multicolored cards to take advantage of his ability to draw cards and gain an advantage. The deck also includes cards like Vanishing Verse and Bring to Light to control the board and find key pieces when needed. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds an additional dimension to the deck's control strategy, allowing for more value and versatility in longer games. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through careful card selection and strategy.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's moves and disrupting their strategy with counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. It also utilizes the companion mechanic to provide additional resources and synergy with the rest of the deck. The key concept revolves around creating a lockdown on the opponent's resources while generating value through card advantage and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in a slow and methodical manner, ultimately leading to a decisive victory.

The deck focuses on control and utilizing the powerful card advantage of Niv-Mizzet Reborn. The deck includes a wide variety of lands to ensure all colors are available for Niv-Mizzet's ability. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw to control the game and stay ahead. The companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value with its blinking ability. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to control the game, generate card advantage with Niv-Mizzet Reborn, and outvalue the opponent to secure victory.

The deck primarily focuses on utilizing low-cost, aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent's life total. It aims to overwhelm the opponent early on with a relentless stream of threats and direct damage spells, preventing them from stabilizing or mounting a defense. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds additional flexibility and consistency to the strategy. By efficiently using its resources and maintaining pressure on the opponent, the deck aims to secure victory by leveraging its speed and proactive game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful control tool, alongside various multicolored spells and cards to maintain board presence and control the game. The deck also includes some versatile cards like Bring to Light and Deadly Cover-Up for added flexibility and disruption. The inclusion of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Leyline Binding helps to further control the opponent's resources and options. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through a combination of powerful creatures and versatile spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck aims to control the board early with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Vein Ripper. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord provides additional creature and lifelink support, while cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Archfiend of the Dross serve as finishers. The deck's mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, allowing for a fast and aggressive playstyle.

The main concept of this Aggro Red Deck Wins Pioneer 1 vs 1 deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent using low-cost aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. By utilizing cards like Soul-Scar Mage, Monastery Swiftspear, and Skewer the Critics, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish a strong defense. Cards like Light Up the Stage and Slickshot Show-Off help to maintain card advantage and push for a swift victory. The inclusion of powerful red mana sources like Ramunap Ruins and Den of the Bugbear ensures consistent aggression from start to finish.
